items.title: Define experience memory schema and storage locations
items.context: Milestone 1: create minimal JSONL schema, project/global storage rules, and story-scoped candidate relationship without treating memory as gate evidence.
items.userSees: Running koala dev_memory_list --scope=project in a project with no saved lessons prints exactly "No dev-memory experience entries yet." Invalid experience JSON fails with a field-level schema error containing "Invalid dev-memory experience"; docs explicitly say "Dev-memory is non-authoritative context, not Koala gate evidence."

happy.desc: Experience entries validate with required trigger, lesson, reuse prompt, category, and scope fields.

edge.desc: Project memory and global memory paths resolve deterministically without requiring Koala to be active.

adversarial.desc: Experience memory is not accepted as Koala DONE evidence or signed gate receipt.

items.title: Implement capture, search, and list commands
items.context: Milestone 2: add CLI commands to save, search, list, and dedupe experience entries with user-facing text output.
items.userSees: koala dev_memory_capture --kind=failure-mode --summary=... prints Captured dev-memory experience <id>. A duplicate capture prints Possible duplicate: <id> and does not silently create an authoritative-looking duplicate. koala dev_memory_search/list show id, scope, source agent, tags, summary, and lesson.

happy.desc: capture writes a reusable entry and list displays it in newest-first order.

edge.desc: search can find entries by agent, category, trigger, and lesson keywords.

adversarial.desc: duplicate-like capture warns or marks related entries instead of silently creating untraceable duplicates.

items.title: Implement preflight context pack generation
items.context: Milestone 3: add dev-memory preflight task text that finds relevant experience by current project path, agent, and task keywords, then emits a short context pack for Claude/Codex/Gemini.
items.userSees: koala dev_memory_preflight --query="delegate reviewer" prints Dev Memory Preflight, at most five relevant entries, a line count below the 60-line budget, and clear references to source ids instead of asking the Agent to read full history.

happy.desc: preflight returns relevant project and global experience for a task query.

edge.desc: preflight degrades gracefully with a clear empty-state message when no memory exists.

adversarial.desc: preflight output is concise and does not dump unrelated full history or private transcript bodies.

items.title: Implement finish and story-scoped experience candidates
items.context: Milestone 4: add dev-memory finish that writes candidate experience into active Koala story when present, and can export confirmed reusable entries to project/global memory.
items.userSees: koala dev_memory_finish --storyId=B-xxxx prints "Experience candidates written for B-xxxx" followed by candidate ids. The generated story candidate file includes "authority: non_authoritative" and "gateEvidence: false" unless the user explicitly exports a lesson into dev-memory.

happy.desc: finish detects active story and writes story-scoped experience candidates with sourceStoryId and evidenceRefs.

edge.desc: finish outside Koala writes directly to project/global memory without requiring story directories.

adversarial.desc: story candidates remain references/candidates and cannot satisfy delivery, summary, review, or test gates by themselves.

items.title: Add agent wrapper entrypoints for dev-start workflows
items.context: Milestone 5: add lightweight wrappers or prompt generators for dev-start codex/claude/gemini that run preflight first and remind users to finish afterward, without forcing Koala lifecycle.
items.userSees: koala dev_start --agent=claude --query="new reviewer task" --dryRun prints the bounded preflight pack, the resolved agent name, and a finish reminder: run koala dev_memory_finish when this session ends. It does not launch Claude/Codex/Gemini unless an explicit non-dry-run mode is implemented and requested.

happy.desc: dev-start claude/codex/gemini invokes preflight and emits agent-specific startup guidance.

edge.desc: wrapper can run in dry-run/prompt-only mode when an agent binary is unavailable.

adversarial.desc: wrappers do not bypass Koala story flow when a Koala story is active; they only add memory context.
